summary.text: Donald W. Longmuir is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 2 (Stanley) in the 2025-26 Legislative Assembly. The legislature's biography lists Donald W. Longmuir's service as "House since 2017". The member page lists Donald W. Longmuir's committee assignments as including Political Subdivisions (Chairman) and the Education standing committees.

paragraphs.text: The biography lists Donald W. Longmuir's occupation as Retired Small Business Owner.
It lists education as BS, Business Economics, NDSU.

It lists these affiliations and civic roles: Stanley Public School Board, (21 years); Past President, ND Land Title Assoc.; Past President, ND Planning Assoc.; Lions International Melvin Jones Fellow; ND Emergency Managers Assoc. Achievement Award; Stanley Lions Club; Stanley Boy Scout Trust Committee; Trinity Health Foundation; Knife River Lutheran Church.
Donald W. Longmuir is listed as married to Connie with 2 children and 7 grandchildren.
